title: Tidy engine-run state constants and a weak assertion
lead: From the S22 review. source.EngineRun compares state strings instead of the runrec constants, and TestEngineRunRows checks the substring 'ork 1', which also matches 'ork 1*'.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: From the S22 review. source.EngineRun compares state strings instead of the runrec constants, and TestEngineRunRows checks the substring 'ork 1', which also matches 'ork 1*'.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- State checks use the runrec constants.
- The test asserts the exact row text so 'ork 1*' does not satisfy it.
